method: Re-reviewed primary PostgreSQL, EACL, and OpenTelemetry sources; ran the lesson verifier, which compiled and executed both local Python examples and checked code-line readability plus article/metadata boundaries. Captured full-page production screenshots in light and dark themes. No provider call was made.
limitations: The historical five-agent prompts, complete responses, tokenizer, labels and scorer are unavailable; the reported Jaccard mean and human summary were not reproduced.
The diversity paper supports a finding within its NLG research setting; it does not validate this lesson’s historical sample or establish a universal multi-agent result.
The thread/barrier and lineage examples use local constructed fixtures; they do not test a model, database transaction, distributed lock, production trace system or authorization policy.
